fields.statement: Verifier at 8417488d: go test -trimpath ./internal/adapter/claudecode/... passes, including TestSettingsStatusLine (Settings JSON carries a statusLine command, shell-quoted, beside every hook event; none when no command is given), TestLiveUsage and TestUserStatusLine. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(usage-live-record|describe-golden)$' -count=1 passes. usage-live-record.txtar pipes five_hour and seven_day rate_limits into rhiza session status-line and finds session and weekly snapshots in the root's state folder (.rhiza-root/usage.live.json) and, outside a root, in .git/rhiza/usage.live.json. A second input replaces the session snapshot and leaves weekly as it was. Input without rate_limits, or malformed JSON, exits 0 and leaves the file byte-identical (cmp). With no user statusLine nothing is printed; a fake user settings statusLine 'cat' echoes stdin; a failing 'exit 3' command still exits 0. Diff read: limitsDir is the same folder the usage-limit hits use, RecordLive keys snapshots by kind and writes atomically, and session run passes StatusLineCommand [self session status-line].
